newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia sells HRK 120 mln 45-day T-bills at 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatia sells HRK 120 mln 45-day T-bills at 10 pct.

text.p: Croatia's Finance Ministry said it sold 120 million kuna of 45-day treasury bills, priced at 98.782 and an annual rate of 10.0 percent.
The accepted rate, marginally below the weighted bid rate, fell from 16.0 percent at a first auction of T-bills on July 24. This was in line with an overall interest rate decline.
The issue was originally targeted at 80 million but was raised after total bids reached more than double that amount.
Bid rates ranged between 6.5 and 14.25 percent and prices between 99.205 and 98.274 kuna.
The ministry said the next auction of new, 91-day T-bills will be September 17.
